11028|ea44f66d.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|ea44f66d.text: I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

1246|ffaa99f9.name: Vosur Brakthel
1246|ffaa99f9.text: Put your back into it, lad. Hard work and determination--that's the way! Don't let anyone tell you book learnin' is all ye need.

14724|92b80d28.name: Bubulo Acerbus
14724|92b80d28.text:
The exiles of Gnomeregan find ourselves in even more dire straits by running low on cloth reserves!  Perhaps you can help us, eh?!

Bring me extra cloth pieces you might have to help us replenish our stocks.  By donating them, you'll be earning the respect and trust of gnomes everywhere.  That's something that money can't buy!  Well, I guess cloth does, but that's beside the point...

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

2786|c9907ea0.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
2786|c9907ea0.text:
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.

Some of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.

4256|d1bed30c.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|d1bed30c.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a $r!

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5177|331d933d.name: Tally Berryfizz
5177|331d933d.text: That's nice, $N. Go show whatever it is to Vosur over there. He'll answer any questions you have.

5595|2fa06dc1.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|2fa06dc1.text:
Yer looking for an Alchemy trainer are ye?  Just came from there, I did.  Ye'll find Ms. Berryfizz over in Tinker Town where the gnomes gather.  

::sigh:: ...why o' why didn't I take the blue potion.

5595|3804779b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ab5dd850.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ab5dd850.text: Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|e6c8b4c9.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|e6c8b4c9.text: The seers of the old ways, aye I know 'em. The waters of The Forlorn Cavern are where ye can find Eldrun Stormbreaker, $C trainer fer the kin o' the elements.

6569|58cd03a1.name: Gnoarn
6569|58cd03a1.text:
Where Troggs and Leper Gnomes roam stands our home - Gnomeregan.

Our families lost, our homes displaced. Scattered.

Oh how I long for the days of carefree Gnomeregan life, but those days are no more. We must make our stand! We must save Gnomeregan!

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

217-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-progress.text: Grawmug and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler, are still alive.  Your mission is not complete until all 3 have been brought to death.  The Dwarven empire is counting on you, $N.
217-progress.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

263-accept.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-accept.text:
The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, $N.  We need a $r like you around here.  The Trogg problem isn't getting any better.  The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here.  But now that we have a seasoned $c here, let's see what you can do.

Go out and kill 10 Stonesplinter $C and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.  Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
263-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

96243-accept.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
96243-accept.text:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave $C. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243-accept.title: Call of Earth
